senses.gloss: m. (preced.) making amends for robbery, fraud &c. (according to Lev. V, 20—26).
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 47b:6">Yeb. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ניתן לה׳</he> has not the privilege of making amends (and being atoned for); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 71b">Ab. Zar. 71ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 35b:3">B. Bath. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ניתן לה׳</he> has no opportunity of &c.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 48a">B. Mets. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>להי׳</he> as amenable to the law &c.
